title: Observability: provider selection for a session not logged
description: When two providers serve the same algorithm, the first-registered wins silently. No pr_info is emitted at sess_init time identifying which provider was selected. Workaround: GET_STATE exposes provider name in crypto2dev_fd_state_info. But kernel logs do not record 'session X initialized: algo=cbc(aes) provider=wolfssl'. In a post-mortem with only dmesg, a support engineer cannot determine which provider handled a session. Fix: add a pr_debug at sess_init logging algo+provider+op.
close_reason: Acknowledged: already implemented correctly, no code change required
